selected_policy: Cigna ACDF (CMM-601: Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion)

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Symptoms include BOTH of the following: significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing, etc.) and unremitting radicular pain to shoulder girdle and/or upper extremity resulting in disability.
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: Patient describes severe, unremitting daily pain, radiating down the right upper extremity into the shoulder and hand with numbness. Functional impact: Significant disability affecting work and daily activities of daily living.
criterion_evaluations.policy_citation:
[3] Section: CMM-601.4: Initial Primary Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion (ACDF) > Radiculopathy (TOC: S9.1.1) - Radiculopathy
- Symptoms include BOTH of the following:
- significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing, etc.)
- unremitting radicular pain to shoulder girdle and/or upper extremity resulting in disability

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Physical exam findings include ANY of the following: dermatomal sensory deficit, motor deficit (e.g., biceps, triceps weakness), reflex changes, shoulder abduction relief sign, nerve root tension sign (e.g., Spurling's maneuver), unremitting radicular pain to shoulder girdle and/or upper extremity without concordant objective physical exam findings.
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: Physical Exam: Motor: 4/5 triceps weakness; Sensory: C7 dermatomal paresthesias; Provocative Signs: Spurling maneuver is positive.
criterion_evaluations.policy_citation:
[3] Section: CMM-601.4: Initial Primary Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion (ACDF) > Radiculopathy (TOC: S9.1.1) - Radiculopathy
- Physical exam findings include ANY of the following:
- dermatomal sensory deficit
- motor deficit (e.g., biceps, triceps weakness)
- reflex changes
- shoulder abduction relief sign
- nerve root tension sign (e.g., Spurling's maneuver)
- unremitting radicular pain to shoulder girdle and/or upper extremity without concordant objective physical exam findings

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Less than clinically meaningful improvement with at least TWO of the following (unless contraindicated): prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) for six (6) weeks; provider-directed exercise program (prescribed by a physical therapist, chiropractic provider, osteopathic or allopathic physician) for six (6) weeks; epidural steroid injection(s) or selective nerve root block(s) performed at the same level(s) as the requested surgery; Plain x-rays of the cervical spine (including flexion/extension lateral views) have been performed.
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: Medications: Trial of NSAIDs (Meloxicam 15mg daily) and Gabapentin (300mg TID) with inadequate symptom relief. Conservative Management Review: Completed 6 weeks (12 visits) of provider-directed physical therapy. Response: No clinically meaningful functional improvement.
criterion_evaluations.policy_citation:
[3] Section: CMM-601.4: Initial Primary Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion (ACDF) > Radiculopathy (TOC: S9.1.1) - Radiculopathy
- Less than clinically meaningful improvement with at least TWO of the following (unless contraindicated):
- prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) for six (6) weeks
- provider-directed exercise program (prescribed by a physical therapist, chiropractic provider, osteopathic or allopathic physician) for six (6) weeks
- epidural steroid injection(s) or selective nerve root block(s) performed at the same level(s) as the requested surgery
- Plain x-rays of the cervical spine (including flexion/extension lateral views) have been performed

criterion_evaluations.criterion: MRI/CT shows neural structure compression at the requested level(s) that is concordant with the individual's symptoms and physical exam findings and that is caused by ANY of the following: herniated disc(s), synovial cyst or arachnoid cyst, central/lateral/foraminal stenosis, osteophytes.
criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: MRI Report: Examination: MRI CERVICAL SPINE WITHOUT INTRAVENOUS CONTRAST. FINDINGS: C6-C7 foraminal stenosis with C7 root abutment. IMPRESSION: 1. Concordant cervical spine pathology at C6-C7 as detailed above. 2. Severe neural compression concordant with clinical radiculopathy/myelopathy.

criterion_evaluations.patient_evidence: PAST MEDICAL HISTORY: No unmanaged major depressive disorder, psychiatric illness, or substance abuse disorder.

criterion_evaluations.criterion: Documentation of nicotine-free status with EITHER of the following: individual is a never-smoker OR individual has refrained from smoking, use of smokeless tobacco products, and/ or nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to planned surgery validated by objective cotinine testing methods (serum, urinary, or saliva) verified as within the normal range for the testing method and lab at which the test was performed.

notes: The patient meets all medical necessity criteria outlined in Cigna ACDF policy CMM-601.4 for initial primary anterior cervical discectomy and fusion (ACDF) based on the diagnosis of Cervical Radiculopathy. The clinical record demonstrates significant pain impacting daily function, objective neurological deficits (motor weakness, sensory changes, positive Spurling's), and concordant MRI findings (C6-C7 foraminal stenosis with C7 root abutment). Conservative management including physical therapy failed to provide clinically meaningful improvement. Documentation of nicotine abstinence is confirmed via cotinine testing. No unmanaged mental health disorders are reported.
